description: One-call visibility audit for a public website: Sellular visibility score (0-100, A-F), whether llms.txt exists (root or .well-known), tracked directories with no known listing for the domain (submission opportunities, not verified absences), and a better-scoring same-category competitor when one is known. Read-only; results cached 24h per domain. Use when asked to audit or size up a site's overall discoverability in one shot.

domain.description: A domain (example.com) or full URL to scan.
